patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Squarespace and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Squarespace only if your buying job matches “Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanced $99/mo ” rather than Tiendanube's shape. Choose Tiendanube only if your buying job matches “LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Es” rather than Squarespace's shape. Workflow advantage: Squarespace leans checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce; Tiendanube leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Squarespace and Tiendanube share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Squarespace is Design-led website builder with commerce — Basic $16, Core $23, Plus $39, Advanced $99/mo annual (US 2026 tiles); platform transaction fees ; Tiendanube is LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inicial $0, Esencial ~$20 USD, Impulso ~$59 highlighted, Escala .
- Company-size focus: Squarespace (solo, micro, small-business) vs Tiendanube (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Squarespace-leaning checkout-conversion, website-builder-commerce vs Tiendanube-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Squarespace — Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume; Tiendanube — Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market.

Limitations — Squarespace: Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume; Catalog and B2B depth trail commerce-first platforms; Tiendanube: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market; USD amounts are FX approximates; ARS tiles are the source of truth.

Poor-fit cases: Squarespace is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Platform transaction fees on lower tiers can exceed the subscription savings at volume · Tiendanube is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Regional LATAM focus — not a global Shopify peer for every market · Avoid Squarespace if you actually need Tiendanube's motion (LATAM hosted commerce (Tiendanube / Nuvemshop brand) — Argentina ARS tiles: Inic)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
